# Chi-square distribution {#sec-chi2_distrubution}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}
$$
f(x; k) = \frac{1}{2^{k/2}\Gamma(k/2)} x^{\frac{k}{2}-1} e^{-x/2}, \quad x > 0
$${#eq-chi2}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Chi-square Distribution - Probability Density Function with different degrees of freedom"
#| label: fig-chi2-dist

# Set up the plot with appropriate range
plot(NULL, xlim = c(0, 15), ylim = c(0, 0.5),
     xlab = "x", ylab = "f(x)",
     main = "Chi-square Distribution - Probability Density Function")

# Define degrees of freedom and colors
df_values <- c(2, 4, 8)
colors <- c("blue", "red", "green")

# Plot each distribution
for (i in seq_along(df_values)) {
  df <- df_values[i]
  color <- colors[i]

  # Create sequence of x values
  x <- seq(0, 15, length.out = 500)
  y <- dchisq(x, df)

  # Plot the curve
  lines(x, y, col = color, lwd = 2)
}

# Add legend
legend("topright",
       legend = c("df=2", "df=4", "df=8"),
       col = colors,
       lwd = 2,
       cex = 0.9)

# Add grid for better readability
grid()
```
